scenario.topic: Select a theme for the annual science communication workshop

options.name: Storytelling Techniques in Science Communication
options.upside: Enhances participants' ability to connect emotionally with audiences.
options.concern: May require more preparation time for role-playing activities.

options.name: Visual Communication and Data Visualization
options.upside: Improves skills in presenting complex data clearly.
options.concern: Participants may need prior experience with visualization software.

options.name: Communicating Science in Social Media
options.upside: Prepares participants to engage audiences on popular social channels.
options.concern: Limited session count may restrict depth of coverage.

options.name: Ethics and Accuracy in Science Communication
options.upside: Strengthens understanding of responsible communication practices.
options.concern: Discussions may be less engaging for participants seeking practical skills.

shared_context: The annual science communication workshop requires selecting a theme that engages diverse audiences and enhances participants' skills. Four theme options are proposed, each focusing on different communication strategies and scientific topics relevant to current trends.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a science educator passionate about engaging the general public through creative methods.
personas.private_goal: To enhance emotional connection skills in science communication.

A.reason_for: Focuses on narrative skills and role-playing which boosts emotional connection with audiences.

B.reason_for: Visual tools can help clarify complex data, useful for educators.
B.reason_against: Target audience is more specialized, less focus on general public engagement.

C.reason_for: Digital platforms are important but sessions are limited and less focused on emotional storytelling.
C.reason_against: Only three sessions may restrict depth, and target audience is young adults, not general public.

D.reason_for: Ethics are important to responsible communication, which supports trust-building.
D.reason_against: May be less engaging and practical compared to storytelling techniques.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a young digital media specialist focused on reaching young adults via social platforms.
personas.private_goal: To master effective science communication on social media channels.

A.reason_for: Storytelling is useful but may not translate well to fast-paced social media.
A.reason_against: Role-playing requires preparation which may not fit social media dynamics.

B.reason_for: Visual communication skills enhance content clarity, important for online platforms.
B.reason_against: Some participants may lack prior software experience.

C.reason_for: Directly targets digital platforms and young adults with interactive content creation.

D.reason_for: Ethics are important but less relevant to fast-paced social media content creation.
D.reason_against: May be too theoretical and less practical for digital engagement.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is an experienced science communicator focused on maintaining ethical standards in messaging.
personas.private_goal: To strengthen responsible and accurate communication practices.

A.reason_for: Storytelling enhances connection but may lack emphasis on ethics.
A.reason_against: Preparation time for role-playing could distract from ethical focus.

B.reason_for: Visual tools help clarify data but less focus on ethics.
B.reason_against: Requires prior software skills, which may limit accessibility.

C.reason_for: Social media is popular but limited sessions and less ethical focus.
C.reason_against: May not cover depth needed for ethical communication.

D.reason_for: Focuses on ethics and accuracy, strengthening responsible communication.

personas.name: Omar
personas.background: Omar is a scientist and educator who values clear visual communication of complex data.
personas.private_goal: To improve skills in data visualization for effective teaching and presentations.

A.reason_for: Storytelling is valuable but less focused on visual clarity.
A.reason_against: Role-playing may not suit his direct communication style.

B.reason_for: Visual tools and software tutorials directly improve data presentation skills.

C.reason_for: Social media skills are useful but sessions are limited and less relevant to data visualization.
C.reason_against: Focus on young adults and digital platforms is less aligned with his goals.

D.reason_for: Ethics support responsible communication, important for scientific accuracy.
D.reason_against: May be less practical and engaging compared to visual communication.
